Anastasia Aleksandrovna Zolotareva (Russian: Анастасия Александровна Золотарёва born 18 January 2002) is a Russian tennis player. Zolotareva has a career-high singles ranking of world No. 243, achieved on 30 January 2023 and a doubles ranking of No. 254, set on 10 November 2025 by the WTA . [ 1 ] She has won 15 singles and 13 doubles titles on the ITF Women's World Tennis Tour . [ 2 ] Career [ edit ] Zolotareva won her biggest title at the 2022 President's Cup where she partnered with Mariia Tkacheva to win the doubles draw.
